things that literally saved my oily dehydrated skin:  1. switched to a gentle morning cleanser. this is the first thing you need to do. look for non-soaping and low pH cleanser! less stripping, less irritation, better barrier support 2. took a break from exfoliation and strong actives. i paused bha/aha, retinoids, niacinamide and other potentially irritating products  3. stopped using cleansing oil for a while. this one can be really stripping for your skin. but if you still need to remove your makeup, use cleansing milk 🙂‍↕️ 4. speaking of makeup.. i cut back on makeup and used bb cream. foundation can sometimes be too irritating for your skin, so try taking “pausing” makeup or switching to a BB cream (which can be a better alternative to regular foundation) 5. started using barrier-supporting ingredients. ingredients like ceramides and panthenol helped soothe my skin and reduce moisture loss 6. added a humectant to my routine. hydrating ingredients helped attract and retain water in my skin 🙂‍↕️ look for: hyaluronic acid, aloe, ectoin or beta glucan  7. applied hydrating products on a slightly dump skin. this helps your humectants attract more water  8. stopped washing my face with hot water. lukewarm water ONLY. even in the shower  9. focused on staying hydrated throughout the day. no need to explain :) 10. finally started using moisturizer. even when you have oily skin or breakouts, just find something lightweight & barrier supporting. trust me, it helps with dehydrated skin so much. 11. started using sunscreen consistently. yes, every single morning. daily spf helps protect your skin from uv damage, irritation and dryness  12. added hydrogel masks once a weak! the best way for your skin to boost and lock in hydration   subscribe for more oily skin tips 🫶🏻🤍 #oilyskin #dehydratedskin #skincare #sooboojiskin
